record.question: The purpose of clamping catheter before removal is:
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Allow bladder tone to return. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 12, printed Q3. Source limitation: The premise is an outdated, non-routine bladder-training practice; evidence shows no established benefit for routine short-term catheter removal. Hold rather than endorse the rationale. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
